primitives.verbatim_quote: A higher proportion of lefthanders can also be confirmed in the top ranks of other sports, such as fencing (Bisiacchi, Ripoll, Stein, Simonet, & Azemar, 1985), baseball (Coren, 1993; Goldstein & Young, 1996), and cricket (Aggleton & Wood, 1990; Edwards & Beaton, 1996; Wood & Aggleton, 1989).

primitives.breakdown_regime: Breakdown occurs when environmental factors (e.g., equipment design, cultural bias) strongly favor right-handers, distorting natural frequencies.
